item.text:
Built **Little Library**, a small book tracker with reading and finished shelves, an add form, notes you can edit, and a button to mark a book finished. Each book has a direct page and a copy-link button; the link works for anyone who can reach the running app.

Books are saved in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json), with no database or accounts. Run it with `npm start`, then open `http://localhost:3000`. The [README](/workspace/README.md) has the setup details.

The build check and tests pass, including a test that books and notes remain available after a server restart.
